integrity: All simplices, simplicial collapse pairs and critical cells are independently reconstructed and checked by a dependency-free Python checker; human independent validation is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Finite 20-vertex intrinsic graph-metric classification only; nonequivariant. It does not extend to geometric-realization or Euclidean Rips complexes or other generalized Petersen graphs. Publication priority beyond inspected sources is not certified.
title: Integral Vietoris–Rips persistence of the Desargues graph
